parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-payment for renewals. Valid values:

- **True**: Auto-payment is enabled. Make sure that your account has a sufficient balance.

- False: Manual payment is required. To pay for an order, log on to the console. In the upper-right corner, choose **Billing** > **User Center**. On the **Order Management** page, find the order and complete the payment.

Default value: **False**.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Valid values: PostPaid (pay-as-you-go) and PrePaid (subscription).

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

- If PricingCycle is set to **Month**, the valid values are **1** to **9**.

- If PricingCycle is set to **Year**, the valid values are **1** to **3**.

> This parameter is required and takes effect only if you set ChargeType to **PrePaid**.

parameters.name: InstanceCidr
parameters.description:
The CIDR block of the instance if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance.

- 192.168.0.0/16

- 172.16.0.0/12

><warning>The VPC-connected dedicated instance connects to the specified CIDR block. To prevent IP address conflicts, make sure that the CIDR block does not overlap with the private IP addresses of your Alibaba Cloud services.></warning>
><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the dedicated instance.

- vpc\_connect: a VPC-connected dedicated instance

- normal: a classic network-type dedicated instance

><notice>

This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.

></notice>

parameters.name: PricingCycle
parameters.description:
The billing cycle of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **year**

- **month**

> This parameter is required if you set ChargeType to PrePaid.

parameters.name: Token
parameters.description: A security token used to prevent duplicate requests. Do not reuse the token. The gateway automatically removes leading and trailing spaces from the token string.

parameters.name: UserVpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the user VPC to which you want to connect. This parameter is required if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance. ><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description: The zone where the instance is deployed. This parameter is required for classic network-type dedicated instances. This parameter is optional for VPC-connected dedicated instances.

parameters.name: ZoneVSwitchSecurityGroup
parameters.description: The zone, vSwitch, and security group information required for network connectivity. This parameter is required if the instance is a VPC-connected dedicated instance. ><notice>This parameter is available only for invitational preview and is not publicly available.></notice>

sub_parameters.name: CidrBlock
sub_parameters.description: The IPv4 CIDR block of the vSwitch.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
sub_parameters.description: The ID of the security group. Services in the same security group can access each other.
